title: GTA Weekend Pizza Mission: Two Laredo Favorites, One Gaming Weekend
excerpt: With GTA VI launch week in full swing, Laredo gamers have a weekend challenge: grab a pizza from Jalapeños Pizza & Wings and another from Domino's, then settle in for a gaming session with friends and family.
content:
GTA VI is one of the most anticipated entertainment releases in years, and launch week has Laredo gamers fired up — and hungry.

The weekend challenge is simple: two pizza missions. Mission 1 is Jalapeños Pizza & Wings, at 9802 McPherson Rd. or 3502 Clark Blvd., Suite 103. Mission 2 is Domino's Pizza, at 4301 San Bernardo Ave. or 611 Shiloh Dr. Complete both missions anytime this weekend.

Gather your crew, fire up the console, and enjoy a weekend of gaming, good food and great company.

Drive safely, Laredo.
